reasoning_traces.think:
The system exhibits a dual-mode operation: autonomous detection (9.0/10) versus human execution (6.5/10). Buyer intent decays exponentially, creating a time-sensitive window for monetization. Listings operate on a lifecycle where renewal is critical for visibility. The core bottleneck is the untaken taps—Garrett’s replies—which prevent any revenue flow despite healthy detection. This creates a failure mode where the engine is capable but constrained by human latency. The system's structure implies that optimizing for agent-driven reply automation will unlock the full potential of the autonomous lanes.
